rounds.text: BLB Ltd is currently trading at a significant disconnect from its fundamental performance, with a P/E ratio of 3.1x compared to a sector benchmark of 19.73x [E1, E6]. The company displays exceptional capital efficiency, boasting an ROE of 29.3% and an ROCE of 40.2%, both of which vastly outperform their respective sector benchmarks [E9, E10, E12, E13]. This operational strength is underscored by a massive 763% growth in compounded profits over the trailing twelve months and a 38% increase in sales over the same period [E15, E17]. Furthermore, the company maintains a fortress balance sheet with zero debt and a current ratio of 20.10x, providing immense financial flexibility [E31, E32, E52]. While the market currently prices the stock at a 0.65x price-to-book ratio, a discounted cash flow analysis suggests an intrinsic value of Rs 254 per share, implying a substantial margin of safety [E2, E38, E39]. Conceded: the company pays no dividends [E4, E55], faces a high annualised volatility of 76.3% [E47], and has a cash conversion ratio of 0.45x which warrants monitoring of receivables [E27].
